name: My Calculator
summary:
Calculation functions: Enter and edit expressions directly, and make use of the available scientific tools. For trigonometric functions, you can choose between degrees and radians, depending on your needs.

History and customization: Review your past calculations and navigate through your history using the up and down buttons; you can also clear the history whenever you like. Additionally, you can select your preferred language and switch between light and dark themes—the app remembers your settings.
